newsitem.title: FINLAND: Niinisto clarifies Finnish spring '97 f/x buying.
newsitem.headline: Niinisto clarifies Finnish spring '97 f/x buying.

text.p: Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto on Wednesday clarified remarks he made earlier in the day about active buying of foreign currencies this spring by the Finnish government for state debt servicing needs.
Niinisto said his earlier comments about the timing of foreign currency purchases -- 42 billion markka this year -- had been incorrect.

"Roughly half of that amount will be bought during spring and clearly more than half before autumn," Niinisto said, correcting his earlier statement that clearly more than half would be bought in spring.
At end-1996, the state's foreign currency denominated debt was 175.0 billion markka, according to state treasury figures.
